method.lead_time: Merged PRs in the window, opened to merged, in hours. Bot PRs (Dependabot) excluded. Median and nearest-rank p90.
method.throughput: Merged non-bot PRs per ISO week; weeks with no merge count as 0.
method.change_failure: Proxy: merged PRs whose title starts with 'Revert' or contains 'hotfix', as a share of merged non-bot PRs.
method.restore_main: Runs of ci.yml on pushes to main. A red episode starts when a run fails while main is green and ends when the next run succeeds; time between the two run ends, in hours. Cancelled runs are ignored.
method.first_push_ci: For each merged PR, the earliest ci.yml run triggered by the PR; it passes if that run succeeded. Cancelled or skipped first runs are not judged.
method.issues_closed: Issues closed as completed in the window (GitHub search).
method.releases: Published, non-draft GitHub releases in the window.

restore_main_hours.reason: Not derivable: .github/workflows/leanup-actions.yml deletes all but the latest ci.yml run every night, so only runs since 2026-10-28 remain for a window that starts 2026-08-03.

first_push_ci.reason: Not derivable: .github/workflows/leanup-actions.yml deletes all but the latest ci.yml run every night, so only runs since 2026-11-01 remain for a window that starts 2026-08-03.
